method: Same source, isolated sequential new-process full/minimal runs with seed 777 and PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
V5 grouped tracing and native 1000-tile map; ten default turns, two Egypt steps (turns 2 and 3).
No heavy validation concurrent with timings; construction, canonical hashing, F12 index and profiling excluded from step timing.
Single timing run per policy; machine-specific observations, not a statistically repeated latency guarantee.
cProfile run is separate; cumulative times overlap and include profiler overhead.
Complete economic object graph, quantities, histories, registries and RNG compared; only registered domain UUIDs, observational recorder fields and journal-clock gaps normalized.
Padded wilderness facts are intentionally omitted; protected values and source relationships compared separately with explicit identity remapping.

protected_evidence.name: default
protected_evidence.normalization: Run/domain UUIDs, journal clock sequence gaps, checkpoint digest/count metadata; all protected IDs remapped by event identity/occurrence; quiet recipe price IDs remapped by tile/good/value (observation date intentionally differs). No economic quantities removed. Clock-derived operation IDs are consistently renamed by their stem and occurrence, preserving associations.
protected_evidence.new_link_validation: Route quote additions match frozen tile/good/price inputs; added migration food sources match full-policy quote values and reproduce the frozen neighbor mean. Existing source order and all other fields remain checked.
protected_evidence.excluded_kind_count_limit: Quiet grouped non-price cells are skipped before expansion; excluded-kind counts are diagnostic and not a full inventory of all omitted expanded cells.
